searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two — gevurah critique the awtsmoos cuts through convenient paint that would leave old machinery below; awtsmoos.com becomes stronger when the live contract is preserved while hidden complexity has nowhere to grow. twenty improvements 1. do not delete the historical ensuretrackstyles export if callers outside the traced path may still import it. 2. make the compatibility style initializer inert and document static ownership. 3. keep rendertracks signature unchanged. 4. keep rendertrackrow signature unchanged for any direct consumers. 5. keep createcommandbutton and durationpill exports unchanged. 6. keep selection exports unchanged. 7. keep cache api unchanged. 8. avoid reusing search .premium track row rules for browser tracks unless selectors intentionally overlap. 9. scope track browser css to list tracks and .premium event toolbar where practical. 10. keep toolbar copy wrapping and min width:0 so long event titles cannot widen the page. 11. keep command decks gridable at 720px and narrower. 12. make 44px the minimum command/checkbox/main title hit area. 13. use safe dom for all title/cache/selection text. 14. do not animate width/height; use transform, border, background, box shadow, opacity. 15. add reduced motion only to this subsystem rather than global animation suppression. 16. preserve cache saved visual state. 17. preserve selected count updates and disabled add truth. 18. preserve event one file download vs multi file zip wording. 19. verify no runtime style element id remains necessary after migration. 20. run all seven existing rebbe tests plus new track contracts after code is complete.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he track browser — post implementation delta the awtsmoos renews the work after the work, so success cannot disguise a missing seam; awtsmoos.com compares intention with evidence until each remaining shadow enters the beam. planned remove the live runtime track stylesheet factory. preserve historical public render/command/selection/cache exports. replace track innerhtml, .onclick, and injected styles with safe readable dom and listeners. split toolbar, controls, and interaction css into static route local modules. preserve selection count, cache saved state, download vs zip wording, playlist, cache, bookmark, and play behavior. keep every touched source 249 lines, so any studio touch requires a full modular split rather than a local tweak. loaded styles/ui.css still includes a raw 9999 layer; styles/boot.css includes 10000. index.html still contains inline style ownership for ctx menu and matrix bg, including raw z index values; do not touch until exact ownership/status is proven because the entry file is large and would require a deliberate modular strategy. historical style.css also contains raw layers but is not loaded by the main rebbe entry and remains out of scope unless another live entry proves it active. delta 1. mark track browser complete in the durable ledger. 2. trace bookshelf import/caller/render/style ownership and git status. 3. if bookshelf is live and clean, migrate its runtime style factory to static scoped css and modernize its visible dom safely. 4. add focused bookshelf tests and rerun the complete rebbe suite. 5. start a fresh isolated server for live route proof after bookshelf closure. 6. then open the larger studio layer/form control wave with its own three phase plan. next action update remaining work, then inspect bookshelf ownership, source, import graph, line count, and existing css contracts before any mutation.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase one — bookshelf revelation the awtsmoos remembers without being limited by memory or shelf; awtsmoos.com lets each saved teaching return as a luminous vessel, never a hidden style spell unto itself. proven reality ui/bookshelf.js is live through render.js and main.js. public contract: renderbookshelf(bookmarks, { onopen, onremove }). current source is git clean before this bookshelf wave. current renderer mixes grouping, section construction, card construction, callback binding, empty state, runtime style injection, innerhtml, and .onclick. no static bookshelf selectors exist in the loaded stylesheet graph. the runtime css is one compressed string and does not provide a complete explicit hover/active/focus visible/disabled/reduced motion contract. possibility field keep renderbookshelf() as the stable public gateway. move grouping/render coordination into a tiferesbookshelfview. move safe card/section construction into a malchusbookshelfcardfactory. use textcontent for all saved bookmark data. replace .onclick with addeventlistener. use explicit semantic buttons with 44px minimum touch targets. keep open and remove visually distinct without clutter. make cards responsive through auto fit with a minimum that still works at 320px. preserve folder vs track visual identity through classes, icon, and metadata—not browser default controls. give empty state deliberate glass/dashed styling. add hover lift only on fine pointers. add active press, focus visible ring, disabled state, and reduced motion fallback. keep every style selector under the rebbe bookshelf root/classes so no global form/button leakage occurs. import static bookshelf css through runtime ui.css. add regression tests that fail if runtime style injection, innerhtml, or .onclick returns.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two — gevurah critique the awtsmoos cuts away the shortcut that merely moves old confusion to another place; awtsmoos.com becomes truly clean only when ownership, semantics, mobile geometry, and code all share one face. twenty improvements 1. do not keep the old styles() function as a no op because nothing outside the file imports it. 2. do keep the public renderbookshelf export unchanged. 3. avoid with nested action semantics that imply the whole card itself is clickable when only buttons act. 4. use a section/list like card vessel with explicit controls. 5. use replacechildren() for root clearing. 6. do not interpolate bookmark title/folder/path into html strings. 7. preserve item identity exactly when invoking onopen(item). 8. preserve removal identity exactly through onremove(item.id). 9. group unknown/non folder item types under the historical track bucket. 10. keep folders before/after tracks according to object insertion from reduction, matching current first seen grouping semantics unless evidence requires order changes. 11. use minmax(min(16rem,100%),1fr) or equivalent so cards cannot force phone overflow. 12. use min inline size:0 on body/title/meta/action areas. 13. let metadata wrap anywhere rather than widening the rail. 14. use icon/spine only as decoration with aria hidden where applicable. 15. give buttons explicit labels and type="button". 16. make remove destructive but not visually dominant over open. 17. ensure action row collapses to one column on very narrow phones. 18. keep animations to transform/border/background/shadow/opacity. 19. avoid generic .modal btn styling as the primary bookshelf ownership layer; add local .book action classes. 20. regression test the static import graph as well as source tokens.
